khiloyhenho uhehsti atsinehti kehsehsti utsathinho uhehsti khilohskini nuhvna kehsehsti atsiki'ehtikw kehsehsti nahski nahskwo uhv'i
nahski ntikalhstohtiha tsitekatsiyalilohstaneha anikowhahthihskvynho vtlha yinathvkiha ale vlha yinolhihka
ale anehv utohiyunhv ihsaya tsutolehohse'i hi'a tsinuwehse'i itsathvkihskv itsathvkihskehsti ahsenho vlha yitsolhihkehsti ale itsikowhahthihskv itsikowhathihskehsti ahsenho vlha yitsatolehohskehsti
nihihskini titsikhahtholi tikalvkwohthanvhi nahskiynho takowahthiha ale tetsililuhkv'i nhskiyenho tathvkiha
nahski iyuhsti nihi itsathvkvka talhilohstv awhski
iyuno khilo athvkvka khanohetv kalvlati ehi ukvnyuhi kehsv ukvwalhi nikolhikvnanho tsikehso'i nhakwo unekutsitv ka'luhko'i ale uki'eho awhsv unawhiyi nahski hi'a unohulhohti tsawhihse'i
hi'anho nahski nvyohi tsawhihse'i nahski tsathvkihsko khanohetv ale khilakwo iyvtv ulihelitsvhi tsitatanilvko'i
ahsenho nitunhahstetlvnakwo kehso'i ale lhekakw tsitakhanhwateko'i akilhiyyhenho kananuko'i ale khanohetv tvlhi'y'ilvhsta akateyahthohta khilakwo iyvt tuwotehiho'i
nhkwnho ulhiyenhv ale ukahthathan nahskwo uyo unanukotse'i
nhkwonho ahskaya kanela tsunvhsitahsti kvwaluhtsele'i hi'a nikvwawehsele'i hskinvhsitahsti lahsko ohstv uktha yitsawhihse tsalokehsv'i' kato tikalhstohtha uyo tsuyhehka'
hi'an nituwehsele'i khilo akhskaki nahski nutvnelv tsunvhsitahsti hi'a nikvwhsele'i tsatulihskono okiyhihsvhstiyi'

unelaki ikulaha witathvhi khvnhi akahthvnatsvha nhakwnho akahthvnatsv hi'a ntakatsiwehseli anihskutehski ikvyi itsitlhihsa uyo ale titstvtsa tikohvhstohti utsalehstihskini itsitlhihsa akihskwankotohtiyi

nhski utohiyuhsv tswtakonatvhti uhstikhiyu kehsv nika'v ukhahtha ahsenho athvhi tswtakonatti uthvniyu kehsv nika'v uyhenha'v'i ale tluhkv tsinikalhstiha nahskinho tsihskwa tsaniluhko'i tuwanikalhv tsanahatihsko'i
nahski hi'a nikatiyu tsihsa tuwonhehthanvki unitsathi tulhilohstanelvki nitalhilohstanehvnano kehsv vlha yituwonhehthane'i
nhkwono tsihsa tuyelihihsthanv unitsathi atanelv wuyvlhvki kvwhstawatitohinho kvwaluhtselvki hi'a nuniwehsvki tihskiyohsihsahsi talhilohstv uyo tsulhiyenhe tlokehsi
unhetsnho hi'a ntuwehselvki nahski na ohstv ukhahtha tsuwhihse'i nahski yvwi uwetsi
nahskinho uyo tsanilhihsihsko ale tsanakohvhstihsko atsilvyi nhskiyahskini nahskw nuhstehsti alhskwatvha hi'a elohi
yvwi uwetsi totakanvhsi tsutseli tinikhanhawatitohi ale nahski utselikohi totvnotsalehsi nikatv tinatatotehstihski ale nhikatv anihskanvki
tikolhvhsvnho atsilvyhi witotvnata'ehsi nanh taniyvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhuhtohkv'i
nhakwonho unatanhvhthi kvwanithalukihski kehsehsti unitota utselikohi nvto nahskiya'i khilo tekalilhukehsti uthvkotiyhi wathvkvka
ale nahskw kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo akayaluti tswunata'invhse amekwohi ale tsituniniyvhe nani'v tsunatalenhvtv
nahskihskini nuhstehsti elohi alhskwatvha tinikhanhawtitohi tvni'luhtsi totvnakalenthani uninekutsitv ale untanhvhthi
uninekutsitvnho witotvnata'ehsi tikolhvhsv atsilvyi nanha taniyvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhuhtohkv'i
tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki itsolihkitsu nikatv hi'a' v'v tskvwiyuhi vkvwohselvki

nhkwnho hi'a nituwehselvki nhski iyuhsti khilo tikowhelihski kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ukvwalhi akeyhonvhi tsikehso'i nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela tsitotikananukowhihsko tsukvwalhohti uhskwanikhoht tsutalenhvtv titse ale tsuwethi

nhkwnho uwahsv utselikohi uluhtsv tsunilawi'ihstiyi tuweyonhvki nhski iyuhsti unihskwankohsvki ale hi'a nuniwehsvki kato ulhstohthanv hi'a nahski ahskaya tsaktha nha'a ale uhskwanikohti tsitulvwhstaneha'
hi'akhani tinehskehski uwetsi melikhani utsi alekhani analhinvtli tsimi ale tsohsi ale hsawani ale tsutahsi'
alekhani tsuto nikatv ehskanhi tsaneha' katonho ulhstohthanv hi'a nikatv tsuweha'
vlhanho yutsathe uhskwanikti nnha yitulvwhstanele'i nanohiyuhvhskena kehsv ntakalhstohtihskvki
nahnyu elot nvhki ikatuki kehsv hstatuki atsikathitihsti uthvkane tekanotsalhv tsihsa
hi'anho nituwehsel tsunvhsitahsti hi'a nhski tsani titawehski to'ulenhv tsuyohuhsvki ale nahski iyuhsti uhskwanikhotiyu tsitulvwhstaneha
elotyenho uniyvhe tsani ale ulhvle'i ale uhstunhe titahstutiy kwiliki elot tinatanhvlhi utali'i elotihsi tsuto'itv uhstvtihske'i

nhski iyuhsti uhselithane uthu'ihstanele unhehti'y nuhstvkwo uthayohlv'i
nhakwonho utsi uweyhonhvhi nikehse'i hi'a nuwehse'i anhi hskiyohelvha tsani titawohski uhsko athelito kalhohtehsti
uhskono uniyholhe athelitokihi ale uninhele athv nahskinho utsi wunhele'i

tsihsanho utsa'ihsv tukohvki unitsathi yvwi al twetolitsvki ale tunhvwanvtsunitlvki

uhsnho nulhsthanv kvwhstawtohi kvwaluhtselvki hi'a nuniwehsvki anhi inakekwo ale ika ulohsonhit tsitsenakwon kiyohsi hi'a unitsathi yvwi ale totikatuhv wi'anilohi nanha unvhsv unalhstayvhti uniwhahsvha

nikalvkwtihskvnanho ikehsehsti utota ale utsi vtlha uhskanvtsvhi yikehsehsti itsatihsko'i nahski hi'a ethi anehi uninhohelhi itsvhthanv ahsekwo nitsvnelv unelanvhi unhetsvhi

unhetsnho hi'a nuwehsvki vlha khilo titsiwahthvhtiyi yvkhinetshelv awhi uninotena unalenlvhi unvhsv ihsili hsitanelvhi khsv'i

kvwahstawatitohinho hi'a nkwawehselvki hatlvnho yotsiki nhski ika'i alhstayvhti inake'i nhski iynitsathi yli tsunolhvhihsti'
